title: Concept-pixel vegetation with continuous bark mapping and separate native wind foliage
summary: User-approved HD conifers and native grass copies with 64x64 inventory icons, compact item-only atlases and a fixed 22.5-degree grass-grid yaw. Native creation/reload verified; the 1.6.1 visual result was approved by the user. The installed 1.12.2 autumn maple S/M/L resolved cutout-alpha fringe defects after earlier branch and foliage revisions; the user approved the final visual result on 2026-10-21.
problem_class: reference-pixel texture mapping and branch-only native wind on custom trees
problem_description: The user requested a separate trial using actual concept pixels, then rejected the vanilla Fir geometry but liked its wind effect. Applying a photographed bark panel to each short trunk segment repeated the photographed trunk silhouette/background and caused discontinuities. Applying block-wide Wind to a monolithic tree would not isolate the foliage.
context: User reports invisible 1.6 icons and requests grass grid slightly skewed relative to the block. Reuse existing FAIL-000025 native 64px icon rule and FAIL-000021 item-texture isolation. Same EXP-000012 asset lineage; installed only in backed-up QA world. On 2026-10-18 the user approved the 1.6.1 appearance before requesting unified mod packaging.
constraints: Do not invent detail while claiming original pixels
Use only native Wind effect on foliage
Preserve prior assets and production save
255 nodes per native model; combined prefab preview may contain more
Client rendering and FPS cannot be inferred from headless tests

solution_versions.description: Autumn Maple S/M/L in the unified Zytale mod: approved bark and roots, seven staggered primary boughs with attached forks, irregular detailed foliage and binary-alpha Cutout textures. The user approved installed 1.12.2 on 2026-10-21.
changes: 1.12.0 delivered the three whole-tree IDs with static wood and native Wind foliage; user rejected texture definition, excessive exposed branches and unnatural crown.

1.12.1 reused the approved tree bark, reduced each tree to seven primary boughs and fourteen secondary forks, added overlapping solid collars at joins, and replaced broad crossed cards with smaller maple sprays. User said the result was practically desired but identified black specks and red edges.

1.12.2 normalized the existing foliage atlas to binary Cutout alpha (0 below 128, 255 otherwise), keeping all retained RGB pixels and all geometry, item definitions, UVs, wind settings and Java classes unchanged.
The same S/M/L item IDs and existing-world placement contract were retained; no production-world rewrite was performed.
advantages: Matches the approved vegetation bark texture and has visibly joined, less crowded branches.
Removes low-alpha specks and red border residues without recoloring retained leaf pixels.
Preserves established whole-tree placement, NESW rotation, removal and static-wood/native-Wind behavior.
User explicitly approved the installed 1.12.2 result.
disadvantages: Specific to the installed Hytale 0.7.2 Cutout renderer; other client versions need separate checks.
Long-duration stability and performance were not measured; user acceptance does not establish either.
